errors.evidence: The x-axis tick marks are labeled every two years (1946, 1948, 1950, etc.), not every year.
The y-axis range displayed on the chart is from -10 to 70, not 0 to 70.
In 1948, the value of the solid line is close to 0 (around 3), not 52. The first major peak of approximately 51 occurs in 1950.
In 1950, the solid line reaches a peak value of approximately 51; it does not drop to 10.

errors.text_span: 在1951年，该线的值急剧上升至约67，然后在1952年下降至约12
errors.evidence: The highest peak of approximately 67 occurs in 1952, not 1951. In 1952, the value is at this peak, it does not drop to 12.
The peak in this period is in 1968 with a value of approximately 49, not in 1967 with a value of 50.

errors.text_span: 然后在1976年急剧下降至约2
errors.evidence: In 1976, there is a local peak of around 10, not a sharp drop to 2.
The dotted line starts near 0 in 1946, not at approximately 20.
In 1948, the dotted line is rising from 0 and has a value of approximately 15; it does not drop to 25.

errors.text_span: 然后逐渐下降至1956年的约10
errors.evidence: The dotted line peaks around 1954 at a value of ~30. In 1956, its value is still high, around 28, not 10.
This is a significant over-generalization. The value of the dotted line is still around 25 in 1960 and does not approach 0 until around 1990.
